newsitem.title: USA: RJR seen worth $40-plus with spinoff.
newsitem.headline: RJR seen worth $40-plus with spinoff.

text.p: Oppenheimer & Co analyst Roy Burry said his price target for RJR Nabisco Holdings Corp is $35 if there is no spinoff of its food unit, and $40-plus if there is a spinoff.
"If would be benefical to the stock" if RJR Nabisco management reiterated a statement that they would like to spin off the unit in a year or two, Burry said.
He confirmed that he had raised his rating on RJR Nabisco to buy from hold.

Burry said his buy recommendation on RJR Nabisco in part reflected the fact that the stock has had a significant decline over the past year or two while the overall stock market has made a big advance.
He said this has left the stock at a 45-50 percent discount to the market and, with a 6.8 percent dividend yield, "a record low valuation for the company."
Burry also said RJR Nabisco is beginning to solve fundamental problems with major improvements accomplished in the food business and international tobacco.
RJR Nabisco was up 1-1/8 to 29-1/4 in early trading.
